summary: The meeting presented proposals for transmitting SCED 35 data via an event timeline structure and standardized out-of-band caption formats (WebVTT/IMSC1) using the same payload. Additionally, a new PR 118 was introduced to define authentication requirements for tracks supporting Privacy Pass or Common Access Tokens, while a follow-up discussion addressed the purpose of a specific track for collecting player logs rather than ABR metrics. The session concluded with a question regarding the necessity of explicit authorization mechanisms versus encryption keys for secure track delivery.
